vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: trading-upbit-skill
Version: 1.0.12

The OpenClaw skill is an automated trading bot for Upbit, performing market monitoring and order execution. It securely handles Upbit API credentials by using them locally to sign JWTs for API calls to `https://api.upbit.com/v1`, without any evidence of exfiltration to unauthorized endpoints. All file operations are local to the skill's `resources` directory, and `child_process.spawnSync` is used only in test scripts to execute the skill's own commands. The `SKILL.md` and `README.md` provide clear, benign instructions, including warnings about handling sensitive credentials and the inherent risks of live trading, with no prompt injection attempts against the AI agent. The code aligns with its stated purpose and lacks any indicators of malicious intent.

llm.summary: The skill's code, runtime instructions, and requested credentials are consistent with an Upbit automated trading bot; nothing in the package indicates unrelated or hidden behavior.

dimensions.detail: Name/description claim Upbit automated trading and the code implements market scanning, event generation, and order placement. Required binary (node) and required env vars (Upbit API keys) are appropriate for this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs running node commands (monitor_once, worker_once, smoke_test) and using config.json or OpenClaw env injection. The code reads/writes only local resources under the skill directory, loads config, calls market/Upbit APIs, and does not read unrelated system files or transmit data to unexpected external endpoints.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is instruction-only (no install spec). The package includes application code and a normal package.json (dependencies: axios, jsonwebtoken, uuid) — nothing downloaded from arbitrary URLs or unusual install steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requests only UPBIT_ACCESS_KEY and UPBIT_SECRET_KEY as credentials, which are the exact secrets needed to call the Upbit API. The number and type of env vars are proportional to the stated functionality.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and user-invocable:true. The skill writes state files only in its own resources directory and uses file locks for cron safety. It does not modify other skills or global agent configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a trading bot and will place real orders if given valid Upbit keys and run outside dry-run mode. Before installing: 1) Review scripts/execution/upbitClient.js yourself (it implements the actual API calls and auth) and confirm you trust it. 2) Start with execution.dryRun=true and run smoke_test, monitor_once, and worker_once manually to observe behavior. 3) Provide API keys only for an account you are willing to risk (prefer a limited/isolated test account). 4) Do not commit config.json or keys to source control; prefer injecting keys via the OpenClaw skills-config as recommended. 5) If you want extra caution, run the skill inside an isolated environment/container and monitor network activity while testing.
